# montecarlo_athena_credentials (Data Source)

Athena credentials are the IAM role Monte Carlo assumes to run Athena queries. An Athena connection goes on a data-lake warehouse.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credentials_id` (String) Id of the credentials, as returned when they are created or listed.

### Read-Only

- `assumable_role` (String) ARN of the IAM role in your AWS account that the deployment assumes. Null unless set.
- `aws_region` (String) AWS region to call. Null means the deployment's own region.
- `catalog` (String) Athena data catalog to query. Null means `AwsDataCatalog`.
- `connection_type` (String) The connection type the credentials are for, such as `snowflake`. Fixed once created.
- `created_time` (String) When the credentials were created.
- `external_id` (String) External id your role's trust policy requires, if it requires one. It is not the deployment's `aws_external_id`. Null unless set.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the credentials.
- `storage_type` (String) Where the secret lives. Fixed once created.
- `workgroup` (String) Athena workgroup to run queries in. Null means the `primary` workgroup.
